That sets a per-record flag; until it is set every API route returns 403 Bucket is locked for modifications, which is what all four attempted routes returned across three sessions. The window is thirty days from publishing to unlock and forty-two days from unlocking to publish the change. Any future in-place correction must start at that dialog by hand before any automation runs.
